But first let us understand why lemon water helps with digestion.
Lemon contains:
1. Vitamin C, which supports liver enzyme activity and makes you more energetic throughout the day
2. Citric acid, which improves bile secretion and helps in better digestion and
3. Natural antioxidants that help reduce oxidative stress
A medium lemon provides around 30–35 mg of Vitamin C. This is good for your digestion and cellular repair.
